data.short_description: The owners of Dukunoo Jamaican Kitchen are preparing to open Dukunoo Blue Restaurant in the former home of The Knife. Job listings suggest an opening could come before the end of the year, but no exact date has been announced. The property is an outparcel to Sawgrass Mills Mall.

Dukunoo Blue Coffee Bar will open alongside Dukunoo Blue Restaurant at the former The Knife location in Sunrise. The coffee bar is described as a new addition to the Sawgrass community focused on quality coffee, creativity, and connection. No exact opening date has been announced.

Vanilla Espresso French Cafe submitted state documents to open a new location in Hialeah's Amelia District. The Hialeah cafe will join existing locations in Miami Lakes and Miramar. An exact opening date has not yet been announced.

data.location: 530 S State St, Ann Arbor, MI 48109
data.status: A winter 2027 opening date is anticipated
data.short_description: The Halal Shack is opening in the University of Michigan Union basement at 530 S State Street. This will be the company's second Michigan location after Oakland University. A winter 2027 opening is anticipated.

data.location: 530 S State St, Ann Arbor, MI 48109 (University of Michigan Union basement)
data.short_description: The Subway in the University of Michigan Union basement has closed. The Halal Shack is taking over the space as a new storefront.

data.event_date: Golf course construction scheduled to begin Q3 2027 and wrap up Q3 2028
data.status: moving forward with a $30 million renovation
data.short_description: The private club is moving forward with a $30 million renovation called "Blueprint for Tomorrow," with permits issued for a new wellness club building and a new bar and grill. The first phase also includes an aquatics complex, dining facilities, and a pool. A redesign of the 18-hole course is scheduled for Q3 2027 through Q3 2028.

data.location: Westfield Galleria at Roseville, 1151 Galleria Blvd., Roseville, CA 95678
data.short_description: CHAGEE will open its first Sacramento-area tea shop at Westfield Galleria at Roseville. The shop is part of the mall's corridor closure project. The opening is expected in 2027.

data.location: Westfield Galleria at Roseville, 1151 Galleria Blvd., Roseville, CA 95678
data.short_description: Arc'teryx is coming to Westfield Galleria at Roseville as part of the mall's corridor closure project. It is expected to open in 2027.

data.location: Westfield Galleria at Roseville, 1151 Galleria Blvd., Roseville, CA 95678
data.short_description: Free People Movement is coming to Westfield Galleria at Roseville as part of the corridor closure project. It is expected to open in 2027.

data.location: Second level of the Nordstrom wing, Westfield Galleria at Roseville, Roseville
data.short_description: Joe & The Juice will open a flagship café on the second level of the Nordstrom wing at the Galleria.

data.location: Promenade, Westfield Galleria at Roseville, Roseville
data.short_description: Bacio di Latte, a Brazilian-style gelato shop, is coming to the Galleria's promenade.

data.location: Former Forever 21 space, Westfield Galleria at Roseville, Roseville
data.short_description: Arhaus is planning its first Sacramento store in the former Forever 21 space at the Galleria.
CHAGEE opened a San Diego teahouse at Westfield UTC in July. It is the brand's first pet-friendly format.
Another CHAGEE location is planned at Westfield Valley Fair in Santa Clara.

Bohl, a fast-casual salad and bowl restaurant, is opening its second location at Highland Reserve Marketplace in Roseville. The restaurant announced the plans on Instagram. The opening is planned for 2027.

data.location: 64055 Van Dyke Avenue, Washington Township, MI 48095
data.short_description: The team behind Botanas El Paiza is opening Casa Amigos, a new concept serving the same Mexican cuisine. Co-owner Orlando Guerrero said the opening will likely be sometime next month.

data.location: 5610 Lancaster Avenue, Unit 800, Overbrook Plaza, Philadelphia
data.short_description: Juicy Burger Bar, an independently owned halal smash burger restaurant, will celebrate its grand opening in Overbrook Plaza. The owners have longstanding ties to West Philadelphia. The team recently held a private tasting event.

Kouklet is relocating to a larger space in the former ITV bar. The new location will have an all-day cafe feel, with seating for up to 15 guests and an open kitchen. The revamped bakery is targeting a February opening.

data.status: will remain at its current location until the new space is ready
data.short_description: Kouklet is moving out of its current shop after its lease expired in August. It has been renting month to month. It will remain there until the new space is ready.
Rookies Pub & Grill is opening its eighth location in Schaumburg. Construction at the building is well underway. An opening date hasn't been set.
The team behind Cake & Joe is opening Nomu Nomu Don, a Japanese BYOB restaurant in Fishtown. The restaurant will have 18 seats, including 10 at a sushi bar. It plans to open in November.

data.event_date: Not specified (construction scheduled December 2026 to April 2027)
data.short_description: Zeds Real Fruit Ice Cream is planning a new shop in Northwest Hills, with a $350,000 interior remodel. Construction is scheduled to run from December 2026 to April 2027. This would be at least the fourth Zeds in the Austin area.

data.location: The Collection shopping center, 7959 Broadway, Alamo Heights (San Antonio)
data.status: planning its first San Antonio shop
data.short_description: Zeds is planning its first San Antonio shop at The Collection shopping center in Alamo Heights.

data.event_date: Not specified (construction scheduled January to April 2027)
data.short_description: Burger King will take over a food court space at Grapevine Mills, to be run by franchisee IRMG. The project is a roughly $225,000 renovation of an existing food court restaurant. Construction is scheduled for January to April 2027.
The article lists Timberland among this year's new additions at Grapevine Mills.
Wahlburgers will add 10 new locations in 2027. The locations range from full-service restaurants to airport and Home Depot locations.
Wahlburgers intends to bring a new outlet to the Bass Pro Shops location in Irvine, California.

data.location: Bass Pro Shops, Colorado Springs, Colorado
data.short_description: Wahlburgers intends to bring a new outlet to the Bass Pro Shops location in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
Through a partnership with Bally's, Wahlburgers has secured a spot in the upcoming Athletics Stadium in Las Vegas. The stadium remains under construction.

data.location: The Orleans Hotel & Casino, Las Vegas
data.short_description: A new partnership with Boyd Gaming will bring Wahlburgers to The Orleans Hotel & Casino.

Three Taverns Brewery announced it will close its Decatur flagship and suspend production there for financial reasons. The brewery's Imaginarium location in Reynoldstown and its Ponce Brew Terminal on the BeltLine will remain open.

data.location: Eagle Village Shops, 503 W Lancaster Ave., #210, Wayne, PA 19087
data.short_description: Rival Bros Coffee will open its sixth shop at Eagle Village Shops in Wayne. A spokesperson said the project is still in the early stages. The team targets a Spring 2027 debut.
According to plan review documents, 16 Handles will open between Samba Brazilian Steakhouse and Pho 101 Noodle House. The brand says it has 43 locations and another 67 in development.
Another 16 Handles is set to open in Fort Myers next month, according to Fred Frey.

data.location: 350 First Ave. N., St. Petersburg, FL 33701
data.short_description: Plan review documents show Surge St. Pete opening at 350 First Ave. N., across from Williams Park. The owner was not immediately available for comment.
Saigon Cafe, a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant open since 1999, announced its closure on social media. It will close on November 22. No reason was shared.

data.location: 995 E Memorial Blvd #110, Suite 7, Lakeland, FL 33801
data.short_description: Ocala-based Four Smokes BBQ is among the restaurants opening in Lakeland Street Market, according to submitted documents. A local Facebook group post announced the location as coming soon.

data.location: Lakeland Town Center, 995 E Memorial Blvd, Lakeland, FL 33801
data.short_description: The Lakeland Chamber of Commerce posted that Lakeland Street Market, a market within Lakeland Town Center, is coming November 22. The market blends a traditional street market with a modern retail destination.

data.status: planning to permanently close its doors
data.short_description: Revel, a Korean and Asian fusion restaurant in Seattle's Fremont area led by chef Rachel Yang, will permanently close after 16 years. The owners announced on social media that the final day of service will be December 20. The restaurant has been a community favorite since 2010.

Jeff's Bagel Run celebrated the grand opening of its newest shop at 867 Cypress Parkway in Poinciana. The shop offers 15 bagel flavors daily, house-whipped spreads, and Otus Coffee drinks. The brand opened its first shop in Ocoee in 2021.

data.status: Set to open in early December
data.short_description: Food truck Pacchioni's is preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar restaurant in the former Pizza Bruno space in College Park. The restaurant will serve globally inspired cheesesteaks and a new pizza menu. The concept was founded by Daniel Pacchioni and launched its food truck in February 2025.

data.status: an opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: HomeGoods signed a 10-year lease for a store at Peters Plaza, in a space previously home to Office Depot. It will be the retailer's fourth Triad store, joining Greensboro, Winston-Salem and Burlington. No opening date has been announced.

data.status: planned opening next fall; Construction has not yet begun
data.short_description: Iron & Oak Golf Club is planned as a 24/7, fully automated, unstaffed indoor golf lounge with four oversized bays in West Ashley. Owner Nick Crout says it will have a Lowcountry, dark-hardwood design and be BYOB for members. A founding-member waitlist is open.
Zoto's Diner in Hatfield Township closed Oct. 25 after 53 years in business. The owners announced the closure in a Facebook post. Sheetz plans to take over the vacated space.

Sheetz plans a convenience store, restaurant, drive-thru and fuel center on the former Zoto's Diner site. The township approved its liquor license transfer in July, and site plans were presented in September. Additional approvals from Hatfield Township, PennDOT and Hilltown Township are still required.

data.location: 3791 Betsy Kerrison Pkwy, Johns Island, SC 29455
data.status: will open its flagship showroom and studio
data.short_description: Charleston interior design brand Michael Mitchell will open its flagship luxury showroom and design studio on Johns Island next year. It will be located in the South Island Market master-planned community, which is expected to debut in 2027. Founder Michael Mitchell is a Johns Island native.

data.status: preparing to expand; opening at 7041 Eastport Drive in early 2027
data.short_description: Sur La Table is opening a new location at 7041 Eastport Drive in The Villages in early 2027, according to its website. The retailer sells cookware, bakeware, small appliances and more, and offers cooking classes. It operates in 25 states.

Family-owned Auburn Fabric Outlet will close its 773 Southbridge St. store on December 19 after 16 years. The closure was announced on Facebook and attributed to the owner's age and health issues. The store will continue offering discount fabrics until closing.

data.location: 8713 Santa Monica Boulevard, West Hollywood, CA 90069
data.short_description: Men's boutique Brick & Mortar will close its West Hollywood store at the end of November after more than 20 years. It is holding a 50% off store-closing sale in-store and online. The store was established in 2006 by Evan Hughes.

data.location: The Hoxton Hotel, 5 NW 4th Ave, Portland, OR 97209
data.status: Since opening at the hotel last year
data.short_description: Chef Ethan Leung and his wife Geri opened Filipino restaurant Pamana inside The Hoxton Hotel in Portland last year. The couple previously ran the Filipino food cart Baon Kainan starting in 2021. The restaurant has received a positive community response, especially for its brunch menu.

data.location: 1151 W Pacific Coast Hwy, Harbor City, CA 90710
data.status: planning a restaurant; An opening timeline has not been publicly announced
data.short_description: Public filings show Tokyo Sushi is planning a restaurant at 1151 W. Pacific Coast Highway in Harbor City. The proposed project includes seating for 137 guests indoors and may serve beer and wine. The concept already operates in Simi Valley.

data.location: 100 N Kirk Rd, St. Charles, IL 60174
data.status: looking at an opening date in Q1 of 2027
data.short_description: Parker Hospitality is bringing Match Haus, a sports, food and drink concept, to 100 N Kirk Road in St. Charles. The three-story building will have six pickleball courts, duckpin bowling, three padel courts, a social kitchen and a cafe. Construction is underway.

The Blazin' Burgerz team is opening a new concept, Blazin' Smash Haus, at 3354 Washtenaw Avenue in Ann Arbor. It is owner Farook Issa's second location and will add items like a mozzarella burger and jalapeño smash burgers. The first location opened in Ypsilanti in January 2021.

data.status: An opening date has not been set as the project isn't under construction yet
data.short_description: Elgin council approved a site plan for a 7 Brew drive-thru coffee shop at 1039-1047 Summit Street. The location will be run by franchisee Who Brew. The site is across from a Jewel-Osco and Anytime Fitness.

data.status: opening its new bakery … on November 9
data.short_description: Sadie's is opening a bakery in NYC's Seaport neighborhood on November 9, next door to the existing Sadie's restaurant. It will sell fresh breads, pastries, cakes, cookies and coffee. The bakery will open daily at 7 a.m.
Southern Italian restaurant Oenotri in downtown Napa announced its permanent closure on social media. Its final day at 1425 First Street will be Saturday, November 14. The restaurant opened in 2010.

data.status: opening its third Georgia location … on November 6
data.short_description: StillFire Brewing is opening its third Georgia location in downtown Tucker on November 6, in a space previously home to High Card Brewing and Blue Tarp Brewing. It will feature 18 draft taps, cocktails and local food vendors. A three-day grand opening event is planned.

Pho Binh permanently closed its Katy location, serving its final meal on October 30 after five years. No official reason was given, though the restaurant had operated irregularly after a September fire injured its chef. Four other Houston-area locations remain open.

Salted Melon, a health-focused casual restaurant and neighborhood market, is opening its second Metro Atlanta location in Sandy Springs. It is expected to open in summer 2027. The new restaurant will join the brand's four existing locations.

data.status: expected to open along with the development in 2027
data.short_description: Artisan ice cream shop Chastain Creamery will open a location at Hillcrest in Sandy Springs. It will be the brand's second Atlanta-area location, joining its Buckhead store. It is expected to open along with the development in 2027.
